list.title: Tenant List
list.name: Tenant
list.codeHelp: Used for the X-Tenant-Id header, subdomain (code.example.com) and path prefix (/t/code/). Cannot be changed after creation.
list.codeRule: Tenant code must be 2-32 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, start with a letter and not end with a hyphen
list.codeReserved: `{0}` is reserved and cannot be resolved as a subdomain
list.membersHelp: Accounts that can sign in to this tenant. Other accounts will not see it on the login page or in the tenant switcher.
list.expireTimeHelp: Expired tenants cannot be signed in to or switched to. Leave empty to never expire.
list.logoHelp: Shown as the app logo inside this tenant. Leave empty to generate one.
list.protectedTip: The built-in platform tenant and the tenant you are signed in to cannot be disabled or deleted
list.statusConfirm: Change the status of tenant "{0}" to [{1}]? Members of a disabled tenant can no longer sign in to or switch to it.
list.singleModeTip: Tenant mode is single, so multi-tenancy is turned off. These settings take effect after switching to another tenant mode.
list.packageHelp: Decides which menus the tenant can use. Changes apply the next time members load their menus.
list.adminsHelp: Tenant administrators manage users, roles and departments of this tenant; other members are regular members.
list.adminUsernameHelp: An existing account becomes this tenant's administrator; otherwise a new account is created.
list.adminUsernameRule: Use 3-32 lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter
list.adminPasswordHelp: Only used when creating a new account, at least 6 characters

package.title: Tenant Package
package.name: Package
package.menusHelp: Tenants only see menus in their package. Menu, tenant and package management are platform-only and cannot be assigned.
package.statusHelp: A disabled package can no longer be assigned; tenants already on it are unaffected.
package.statusConfirm: Change the status of package "{0}" to [{1}]?
package.inUseTip: This package is still used by tenants and cannot be deleted
